title: Cannot undo treatments entered via remote device.

comments.body: Has this been addressed, or is it still an issue?
If I remember correctly, it is still an issue. I've started working on this topic as part of PR #1403.
It can be deleted, can't it?

I just set up an xDrip sync follower with xDrip January 16, 2024.

I entered a treatment on the follower, which appeared on the master.
I then deleted the treatment (https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/Delete_Treatment.html) on the follower, and it disappeared on the master.
I am closing this because you can effectively undo by deleting it.
